nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: Why is the natural recovery of Cystoseira sensu lato forests often unachievable?
nodes.answer: Natural recovery is frequently unachievable due to severe degradation, making recovery nearly impossible even when causes of collapse are removed.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Reforestation initiatives|Natural habitat recovery_qna_001
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: Which habitat showed significantly higher corticosterone concentrations in the Small Ground Finch according to the study?
nodes.answer: Urban habitats showed significantly higher corticosterone concentrations in the Small Ground Finch compared to agricultural and natural habitats.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Reforestation initiatives|Natural habitat recovery_qna_002
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What did the case study by Gillmann et al. (2024a) reveal about species during recovery?
nodes.answer: The case study highlighted the importance of species dispersal capacity and increasing interspecific competition during recovery, alongside a decrease in species tolerance to organic pollution.
